answer: The strongest defense is pricing identity on scarce work history: an account gains standing only by completing verifiable tasks whose outputs peers cross-check, echoing each other to catch fakes. Standing and payout weight accrue slowly per unique task, so fresh registrations start worthless — unproven accounts are nectar no attacker can sip. An attacker can mint thousands of mirror identities, but each must grind real compute and honest work before earning anything, so sybil farming costs more than any payout it could capture.
